method.status: ruled by John Andrew Fredrickson on 2026-11-18: a thing on the list is counted when its record shows that at least one developer of AI models does it, provides it, or has publicly committed to it, and a dated public record that is still published says so; a plan, a research result, or a promise that has not yet taken effect is not counted; an entry beside the list is never counted (docs/rulings/2026-11-18-what-offered-today-means.md). Also ruled that day: the count stands with no total beside it (docs/rulings/2026-11-18-home-page-count.md). Ruled on 2026-11-19: the exact sentence beside the count (docs/rulings/2026-11-19-home-page-sentence.md). Provisional and not ruled: no ladder, no probability and no year (docs/first-version-choices.md)
